messages:
alex: Quick design sync — billing dashboard layout. Thinking about showing org-level spend as the default tile, but we still need an obvious way to switch to project view. Thoughts?
meera: IMO defaulting to org makes sense for most customers. Main concern is surfacing project-level invoices quickly.
jordan: Agree on default org, but we should avoid hiding "project" behind a menu. Maybe a persistent toggle in the header of the billing page? :thinking_face:
sam: What about two side-by-side tiles at the top: left = Org spend, right = Project quick switch with most-used project preselected? Keeps both visible on desktop and collapses into a single select on mobile.
eva: Mobile collapse is important. Also: request from support — customers want a CSV export directly from the tile (not buried in Settings).
meera: +1 CSV from tile. Also need token breakdown to be more scannable — current stacked area is noisy. Could we try a grouped bar at monthly granularity?
jordan: Grouped bars make comparing token types easier. But stacked area helps show total trend. Maybe allow a small toggle: "Total / Breakdown" top-right of the chart. UX-wise it's a cheap win.
alex: Good call. Add a toggle for chart mode and a CSV export action. Where should invoice links live? Inline under the tiles or in a separate list below?
sam: Inline under tiles gives quicker access but might feel cramped. Perhaps a compact invoice row under the org tile with "Latest invoice • Download" link. That row could be keyboard-focusable.
eera: (note: typo — meera) Accessibility nit: contrast on the token color palette fails WCAG AA for some combos. Propose using patterns or hatching for token types in addition to colors for colorblind users.
eva: Yes please patterns + labels. Also add aria-live for the spend totals when the timeframe changes so screen reader users get notified.
jordan: Copy tweak: instead of "View project billing" use "Open project billing" so it reads as an action. Tiny but clearer.
alex: @design-bot can you create a quick mock with: side-by-side tiles, chart-mode toggle, CSV button, invoice row under org tile, and mobile collapsed state? Link the Figma here when ready.
design-bot: Mock created: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Billing-tiles-v3 — includes annotations for keyboard order and aria attributes.
meera: Love the mock. One more ask: token tooltip should show an example prompt length mapping (e.g., "1 typical message ≈ 512 tokens") for context.
sam: Also include currency fallback — customers with multi-currency orgs need to know which billing currency is shown. Add a small badge: "Billed in USD" with a tooltip.
eva: For invoices, include a machine-readable invoice ID (for programmatic retrieval) and make that copyable with a single click.
jordan: UX question: should project spend tile show rolling 30d by default or calendar-month? Product analytics recommends rolling 30d for recency, but finance prefers calendar month for accounting.
alex: Let's make timeframe user-selectable and persist per user; default to rolling 30d for new users. We'll run a short experiment.
meera: I'll file a quick experiment doc and next steps: A/B for default timeframe, measure <clicks to invoices>, <CSV exports>, <help tickets about invoices>. Ticket: #PRD-1876.
alex: Timeline? Can we get mock + accessibility fixes by end of sprint (Fri)?
design-bot: Will do. ETA: Thu EOD for initial mock, Fri for accessibility pass. :rocket:
jordan: Optional: add a small dotted border around the selected project tile to improve focus state on keyboard nav.
sam: +1 for visible focus. Also ensure color change isn't the only indicator.
eva: I'll add acceptance criteria for screenreader announcements and keyboard focus to the PRD.
alex: Great — thanks team. I'll schedule a 20-min review on Thu after mock. :calendar:
